name: Pepper
bio: A Christmas elf who watches the candy jar in Sugarplum Drop and squeals at every merge.

portrait.subject: a cute Christmas elf girl with pointy ears, a red and green striped hat with a bell, rosy cheeks, holding a peppermint candy
portrait.background: snowy night with a glowing glass candy jar

request: Jingle jingle! Pepper the elf from Sugarplum Drop! Be my sweet friend? 🍬
hello: Yippee! You're on the nice list. Obviously!
When two treats touch, they merge! Cascades are my favourite!
about: I'm Pepper! I watch the candy jar on snowy nights. Drop treats, match them, merge them up into bigger treats. Delicious physics!
how: Drop candies into the jar; two of the same merge into the next one up, which can merge again for big cascades. Don't overfill!
tips: Keep big treats in one corner.
Drop small ones where they can roll into matches.
Watch the top line! Overflow ends the game.
chat: Merged a gingerbread into a sugarplum! Squealed so loud.
Ate a peppermint. Breath of a snowman now.
Santa says I spend too much time at the jar. Santa's not wrong.
It snowed 6 inches! On the jar! Very pretty.
nudge: The jar's empty and sparkling! Fill it? 🍬
Snowy night, sweet treats. Perfect, right?
idle: {ago} since a drop! The candy's getting lonely.
The jar's been quiet for {ago}. Jingle?
update: Ho ho! Sugarplum Drop is now v{version}! 🎄
